in_arabic.name: Mahnaz
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Graceful, Delicate, Elegant
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mahnaz هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'h-n-z', meaning 'grace' or 'gracefulness'. In Islamic culture, the name Mahnaz symbolizes the delicate, elegant, and refined nature of a woman. It is also a reminder of the grace and elegance that Allah bestows upon His creation.
